name: A card that is first year free

blocks.text: Finder and keep-or-close use ₹0 fee for this card until 15 Nov 2026, then ₹999 + GST.

msgs.what: Your own card can be fee-free even when the product charges a fee (a bank waived it, or it came through a campaign).
The free year's end date is stored with the card.
Finder, keep-or-close and Launch Radar pass this override into the year simulation, so the card is scored without its fee.
After 15 Nov 2026 the override stops applying and the notice board warns 60 days ahead.
